observations: J binary facts streamed MSB first; one bit per update
query_timing: coordinate query supplied after the state is committed
public_update_inputs: phase encoded by a one-hot write gate

primary_checks.all_state_transitions: every binary state, every phase and both incoming bits
primary_checks.all_readouts: every binary state and every coordinate query
primary_checks.complete_words: every binary word with every delayed query
primary_checks.parity_control: every binary word at both compact and padded state budgets
primary_checks.finite_controller_bridge: same neural update/readout compiled into the pinned MIC-18 evaluator

matched_budget_contrast: J coordinates, 2J update ReLUs, J readout ReLUs, identical dense matrix shapes and J updates for register/parity/last-bit query arms
compact_parity_comparison: separately charged one-bit state; 2 update ReLUs per observation
candidate_selection: fixed constructive weights; zero optimizer updates
population_inference: blocked: complete deterministic finite census supplies no trained-model pilot or independent sham roots

source_results.scope: state count supplies an information requirement; this construction supplies one physical realization with explicit work and storage

failure_policy: any matrix mismatch, illegal state, receipt mismatch or source-lock mismatch fails the command
